reviews.text: Nadine is lovely and takes excellent care of the cats with the help of her daughter. It's a real relief to have found such a good boarding facility.

Nadine is a passionate, kind, and incredibly caring person. She takes great care of each of her guests and does everything she can to make them feel at home.

My Carlo loves staying there, and it's a real relief to know he's in such good hands. The photos and updates Nadine regularly sends allow me to go on vacation with complete peace of mind. Every time I return, I find him happy, relaxed, and clearly delighted with his stay.

A huge thank you to Nadine and her daughter Astrid for their professionalism, kindness, and all the love they give our companions.
I've known this cattery for a long time; the owner is very professional, the cats are very well cared for, and I highly recommend it.

A huge thank you to Nadine and Astrid for their kindness, professionalism, and advice. The cattery is fantastic, very pleasant, peaceful, and perfectly suited to each cat's age and personality, with a good balance between communal and individual spaces.

Thank you for keeping us updated and sending us photos that will add to their already impressive album 😉 Until next vacation... 😀

A first for Aubie, who stayed at a guesthouse for six days.

Everything went very well. Nadine kept us updated several times during our stay and also sent us photos. We highly recommend this guesthouse!

Honestly, I recommend it 100%! My little cat, Amour, had a wonderful stay at the cattery; she was pampered just like at home. I received updates, and she was relaxed and happy when I picked her up. Nadine and her daughter Astrid are lovely and truly attentive. Thank you again; Amour will gladly come back.
Corinne from St. Fons

Looking for a "5-star hotel" for your furry friend? Look no further, you've come to the right place. Nadine and Astrid are incredibly kind and extremely competent; they took excellent care of our cat, who returned in perfect health. Their true professionalism and meticulous attention to detail mean you can leave with complete peace of mind. A huge and much appreciated bonus was the regular updates and lots of photos we received. The facilities are comfortable and well-suited, with a perfectly secure and peaceful outdoor area. A trustworthy place where you feel completely safe! Thank you again!

Thank you to Nadine and her daughter who took such good care of my cat, with love, especially since he has a difficult character. I left him with complete confidence because you can tell they are cat lovers and Nadine is very gentle with them. If you want to leave your cat in a place where you are sure he will be well cared for, you can leave him at L'Entrechat. Thank you again, Nadine.

Thank you, Nadine, for the peace of mind you gave us by looking after our little ones (Romie and Winnie) during our 15-day holiday. Your gentleness, patience, and professionalism, along with the regular updates and lovely photos, allowed us to enjoy our vacation serenely and to pick up our little rascals calm and relaxed. They quickly fell back into their old habits (good and bad)!
Thank you for everything, and see you next year.

We entrusted our timid loner to Nadine and her daughter for three weeks: he settled in very quickly, thanks to the great patience and gentleness of his hostesses!
We picked him up in perfect health, and he returned home as if he'd never left.
I absolutely recommend this boarding facility; having visited several in Lyon, this one truly seemed the most reliable: don't hesitate to entrust it to your kitty!
